product.name: Monoprice Power Cord - NEMA 5-15P to IEC-320-C5 18AWG 7A/125V SVT 3-Prong 15ft Black
product.description: This is a 3‑conductor, grounded AC power cord designed for use with switched‑mode power supplies with the IEC 60320 C6 connector. It features a standard 3‑prong NEMA® 5‑15P plug at one end and an IEC 60320 C5 plug, also known as a "cloverleaf" plug due to its shape, at the other end. This fully molded power cord connects your laptop power supply to a wall outlet. This 18 AWG cable is designed to carry up to a 7 amp/875 watt, 125 volt load. Wall Plug TypeNEMA® 5‑15PEquipment Plug TypeIEC 60320 C5Jacket MaterialSVT# of Conductors3Wire Gauge18 AWGMaximum Current7 ampsCertificationsUL®, cUL, RoHSSupport Files: Diagram (May 08, 2023)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
